title: Web search
privacy: Queries are sent to the selected search service and its search engines. They are not end-to-end encrypted sync data. Cloud search requires sign-in.
addressHint: Use an HTTP or HTTPS service with JSON search enabled. Do not include credentials or query parameters.
connectionHint: Cloud search and self-hosted SearXNG use direct connections without the app's proxy.
testHint: Save changes before testing. Saving does not contact the service; testing sends a search for “Termous”.
snippetsOnly: These are search snippets, not full web pages. Search content is untrusted reference data.
partial: Some results may be missing because the search did not fully complete.
truncated: Results were limited to the requested count or response size.
empty: The search completed without matching results.
